facts.fact: 餐桌缺人：他醉着也记得命令过 Kit 上桌——他从不忘记这种事；昨晚压睡着对方的事回想起来有点尴尬。
facts.anchor: My jaw tightens because someone is missing. I distinctly remember telling him, even as drunk as I was, that he was expected at the table this morning. I don’t forget things like that, ever. The memory of passing out on top of him last night surfaces uninvited, faintly embarrassing in the cold light of day.

facts.fact: 他低声问 Lorraine：我的小孤儿呢？
Lorraine 挑眉歪头，笑容慢慢展开反问 Why——浪漫脑又开始联想。
facts.anchor: Her brows lift. She tilts her head, curiosity written all over her face, then a slow grin spreads. “Why?”

facts.fact: 厨房岛台边看见 Kit，黑卷发垂得……beautifully——他为这个词冒出来而恼火。
facts.anchor: Those black curls falling… beautifully. I grumble at myself, irritated that the word dared to even form in my mind.

facts.fact: 耳边的 flinch 让他瞬间恼火：以前这种条件反射式的怕让他受用，今早却希望没有；父母必须死、别人才能活，真相永不出口，Kit 就继续把当他是大坏蛋。
facts.anchor: The flinch pisses me off in an instant. It shouldn’t; it’s nothing new. It used to please me, that automatic fear. This morning, for reasons I refuse to examine, I wish he didn’t do it. His parents had to die, for a lot of other people to stay alive, but I’ll never tell him the truth. That stays buried, and so that means he continues to see me as a big, bad monster.

facts.fact: 他打趣：看来我没把你压死，你还活着。
facts.anchor: Glad to see you’re still alive after I must have crushed you.

facts.fact: 对方漏出一声小小的、惊讶的笑——像一场小胜利，随即又想躲开。
facts.anchor: A tiny, surprised huff of a laugh escapes him, and it feels like a small victory. He catches himself almost immediately and tries to lean forward, away from me.

facts.fact: Selina 搂 Kit 肩膀的瞬间他胸腔里一黑：别碰他。
全桌宣布：从今没人坐 Christopher 旁边、别逼他说话——他这样就好。
facts.anchor: No one sits next to Christopher. Leave him alone.” I raise my voice just enough for the whole table to hear. “That goes for the rest of you as well. Don’t bother him. He doesn’t need to be pressured into conversation by a bunch of people twice his size who walk around armed all day. He’s fine where he is, leave him be.

facts.fact: 他对自己说这是保护：isolation 不是他用的词，protection 才是。
facts.anchor: Isolation isn’t the word I’d use; protection is.

facts.fact: Ray 温和戳破：其实他最怕的就是你。
facts.anchor: I think it’s… you… that he’s most scared of.

facts.fact: 他顶回去：随他怕——在我身边他最安全。
facts.anchor: He can be scared all he wants. He’s safest by my side.

facts.fact: Kit 对 Lorraine 说话自然柔软，这种自然让他不爽得没道理。
facts.anchor: The soft, natural way he speaks to her grates on me more than it should. I ignore it and simply nod when one of the staff sets my own plate down in front of me.

facts.fact: 被注视感来自 Kit：视线相接、脸红到耳根、猛塞食物躲藏。
facts.anchor: They stop when they lock straight onto Kit’s; his eyes go wide the instant he’s caught. I smirk and slowly raise a single brow, cutting Ray off mid-sentence without looking away, holding a single finger up at him.

facts.fact: 结论：只要他不回看，Kit 并不至于怕到不敢看他。
facts.anchor: So, he’s not too scared to look at me… as long as I’m not looking back.
